note: Adapted from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989 (Fauna of India: Isoptera, archive.org identifier dli.zoological.fi.026); the original is in English; the alate is recorded in the original as 'Imago Not known'. OCR problem: the pronotum width of the worker is given in the original as '0.6^-0.67', with an unclear character in the middle, and the text keeps it as 'about 0.6—0.67' with a note; the other measurements are legible. From line 96 of the source package onwards the text belongs to the next species, Reticulitermes tirapi, and was not used.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, the sides almost parallel, head length 1.53, maximum width 1.00 mm, the frons raised into a pair of frontal projections and sloping forward at slightly more than 45 degrees; mandibles short and stout, 0.86 mm long, about half the head length, the left mandible with a scar only at the base and smooth elsewhere, its basal projection prominent, the right mandible smooth with a small tooth near the base; postmentum clavate, widest at the anterior third of the head length, narrowing posteriorly into a slender waist, the waist less than one third of the maximum width. Worker head subsquare, about as long as wide; the small worker is smaller-bodied, with antennae only 13—14-segmented. Alate unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow, labrum yellow with a transparent apex, mandibles dark brown, paler at the base, antennae, legs and body almost white. Head moderately hairy, body more densely hairy. Total body length about 4.0 mm. Head capsule subrectangular (length 1.53, maximum width 1.00 mm), sides almost parallel; frons raised, with a pair of frontal projections at its base, sloping forward at slightly more than 45 degrees. Fontanelle small, circular, situated at the base of the raised frons. Antennae with more than 11 segments, segment 3 shortest, segment 4 larger than segment 2. Boundary between postclypeus and anteclypeus indistinct. Labrum triangular-ligulate, the transparent apex with a pair of long hairs. Mandibles sword-shaped, short and stout (length 0.86 mm), about half the head length; left mandible with a distinct scar only at the base and smooth elsewhere, the basal projection prominent; right mandible smooth with a small tooth near the base. Postmentum clavate, widest at the anterior third of the head length, narrowing posteriorly into a slender waist, the waist less than one third of the maximum width; postmentum length 1.08, maximum width 0.40, waist width 0.12 mm. Pronotum flat, rectangular, widest anteriorly (length 0.40, maximum width 0.67 mm); anterior margin with a distinct blunt median notch, posterior margin with a weak median notch. Mesonotum slightly narrower and metanotum slightly wider than the pronotum, sides rounded, posterior margin straight. Legs slender. Abdomen long-oval, cerci 2-segmented, stylet single-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head capsule yellowish white, labrum pale yellow, antennae, legs and body paler than the head. Head and body densely hairy. Total body length 3.6—3.8 mm. Head capsule subsquare, sides slightly convex; length 1.03—1.07, width 1.03—1.07 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14—15-segmented, segments 3 and 4 ring-like. Postclypeus weakly raised and hairy, less than half as long as wide; anteclypeus hairless and flat. Labrum subsquare, anterior margin rounded. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum flat, rather densely covered with brown hairs; anterior margin weakly convex with a deep median notch, posterior margin with a shallow median notch; length 0.33—0.37 mm, width about 0.6—0.67 mm (the OCR in the original reads '0.6^-0.67' here). Legs slender; tibial spurs 3:2:2; tarsus 4-segmented. Abdomen as in the soldier. Small worker: identical to the large worker but smaller-bodied and with antennae 13—14-segmented; total body length 3.0 mm, head length (to the base of the mandibles) 0.80—0.86, width 0.83—0.90 mm, pronotum width 0.47—0.50 mm.
